comment: Castrum Meridianum's BNpcBase 14540: what it did in three retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 15`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). A draft from Bob's Chronofoil captures (50e72631, 9ba7d981, af05916c), not yet checked in game: ContentFinderCondition 15, BNpcBase 14540, BNpcName 2109, level 50, 2589 HP, 21 seen in 3 runs. `players` and `npcs` are the median damage to each, `every` the median time between uses.

actions.comment: 6 uses; 5.7 s cast; no damage. Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 24 casts by 24 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 22.3 to 31.7 s after the pull (median 30.2; `first_uses`: each NPC draws one of retail's each fight), `every` 96 s (never twice by one: the longest any of them fought). Before, the rotation would have cast it 218 times at most over lives retail's cast it 24.
